configuration.title: Folder Spaces
configuration.spaces.description: Folder-scoped explorer spaces. Each entry is either a path string or an object with `path`, `name`, `icon`, `showFiles`, `include` and `exclude`. Paths may use `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolders[0]}` and `${userHome}`.
configuration.spaces.path.description: Folder path (absolute, or using supported variables).
configuration.spaces.name.description: Display name for this space (defaults to the folder name).
configuration.spaces.icon.description: Optional ThemeIcon id or absolute path to an SVG/PNG icon.
configuration.spaces.showFiles.descripti: Per-space override for showing files in the tree.
configuration.spaces.include.description: Optional glob patterns; only matching files are shown.
configuration.spaces.exclude.description: Optional glob patterns; matching files and folders are hidden.
configuration.showFiles.description: Show files in the tree in addition to folders.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Browsing, opening and copying paths works in restricted mode. Creating, renaming, deleting and other disk-modifying operations are disabled until the workspace is trusted.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Folder spaces currently require local folder paths; virtual workspaces are not supported yet.
